items.title: 1.4 Use of significant figures (significant figures ka istemal) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.4 with the thumb-rule boxes and the Quick Quiz (PDF 9-11).

blocks.text: Kisi measurement ke jin digits (hindson) par hamein kafi had tak yaqeen ho, unhen significant figures kehte hain. Yeh dar asal us instrument ko show karte hain jis se measurement ki gayi. Calculator se calculation karein to answer mein decimal ke baad bohat se digits aa jate hain. Yeh faltu digits doosre shakhs ko mislead (ghalat fehmi mein daalna) kar sakte hain ke yeh sab sahi hain. Is liye answer ko significant figures ki sahi tadaad tak round off kiya jata hai. Iske liye reading likhte waqt instrument ki uncertainty ya least count ko yaad rakhein, aur calculation ka answer bhi significant figures ki sahi tadaad tak likhein. Behtar hai ke answer scientific notation mein likha jaye taake significant figures ki tadaad mein koi ambiguity (shak) na rahe.
Example: ek hi cheez ko do alag balances se tolna:

Aam taur par ± 0.001 g ya ± 0.1 g nahi likha jata; samjha jata hai ke likhe gaye number ke aakhri digit mein kam az kam 1 unit ki uncertainty hai. Jitne digits likhe gaye hain sab significant figures hain: yani pakke maloom digits aur pehla estimated (andaze wala, doubtful) digit. Significant figures ka sahi istemal hamari measurement ki uncertainty ko theek show karta hai. Maslan scientists foran samajh jate hain ke 3.145 g wali reading 3.1 g se zyada accurate (sahi) hai, kyunke woh behtar ya zyada precise instrument se li gayi. Jaise jaise instruments aur techniques behtar hoti hain, result mein zyada significant figures aate hain aur experiment ki accuracy barhti hai.

blocks.alt: Distance (faasla, m) ka vertical (khara) scale, upar 10⁻²⁰ se neeche 10³⁰ tak. Saath: nucleus ka diameter (qutr), atom ka diameter, insan ka qad, Zameen ka diameter, Suraj tak faasla, qareeb tareen sitare tak faasla, Milky Way ka diameter aur qareeb tareen galaxy tak faasla.
blocks.caption: Kuch distances ka order of magnitude (For Your Information; kitab ke chart ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Yeh scale bhi 10 ki powers mein hai: har bara nishan pichhle se 10¹⁰ guna bara faasla hai. Atom taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m, insaan taqreeban 1 m, Zameen ka diameter taqreeban 10⁷ m aur Suraj tak faasla taqreeban 1.5 × 10¹¹ m hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Kitab ka chart qareeb tareen galaxy ka faasla taqreeban 10²⁸ m ke paas dikhata hai. Qareeb tareen bari galaxy (Andromeda) asal mein taqreeban 2 × 10²² m door hai, is liye upar ke chart mein use Milky Way ke diameter (taqreeban 10²¹ m) ke foran baad rakha gaya hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Working with significant figures (significant figures ke saath kaam)
(i) Counting significant digits (significant digits ginna)

items: Sab digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 significant hain. Zero significant ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi; zero ke liye yeh rules hain:
Do significant digits ke darmiyan wala zero significant hai (maslan 205 mein 0).
Significant digits ke left (baen taraf) wale zero significant nahi: 0.00467 ya 02.59 mein koi zero significant nahi.

Significant digit ke right (daen taraf) wale zero significant ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi. Decimal wale number mein right ke zero significant hain: 3.570 aur 7.4000 ke sab zero significant hain. Magar 8,000 kg jaise integer (poora number, bina decimal) mein zero kitne significant hain, yeh instrument ki precision batati hai: least count 1 kg ho to chaar significant figures, 8.000 × 10³ kg; least count 10 kg ho to teen, 8.00 × 10³ kg, waghaira.
Scientific notation mein 10 ki power ke ilawa sab digits significant hain: 8.70 × 10⁴ kg mein teen significant figures hain.

blocks.text: (ii) Multiplying or dividing numbers (zarb ya taqseem)

Multiply ya divide ke answer mein utne hi significant figures rakhein jitne sab se kam accurate factor (yani sab se kam significant figures wale factor) mein hain. Example: calculator yeh calculation yun deta hai:

Kitab calculator ka answer 1.45768982 × 10³ chhapti hai. Sahi answer 1.45708982 × 10³ (yani 1457.09) hai. Teen significant figures tak round karne par dono 1.46 × 10³ hi bante hain, is liye final answer sahi hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Final answer ke liye: addition/subtraction (jama/tafreeq) mein same precision (decimal places); multiplication/division (zarb/taqseem) mein same accuracy (significant figures ki ek jaisi tadaad).
blocks.title: Remember Thumb Rule (Yaad rakhein)

blocks.text: Upar ki calculation mein sab se kam accurate factor 3.64 × 10⁴ hai, jis mein teen significant figures hain; is liye answer sirf teen significant figures tak likha jaye. Baqi digits insignificant (be-maani) hain aur hata diye jayen. Digits hatate waqt aakhri rakhe jane wale digit ko in rules se round off karte hain:

items: Agar hataya jane wala pehla digit 5 se kam ho to aakhri rakha gaya digit waisa hi rehta hai.
Agar hataya jane wala pehla digit 5 se zyada ho to rakhe jane wale digit mein 1 barha dein.

Agar hataya jane wala digit 5 ho to pichhla (rakha jane wala) digit odd (taaq: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9) ho to 1 barha dein, even (juft: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8) ho to waisa hi rehne dein. Neeche ke numbers teen significant figures tak round kiye gaye hain; digits ek ek kar ke hataye gaye hain.

blocks.text: 56.8546 mein digits ek ek kar ke hatayein: 56.8546 → 56.855 → 56.86 → 56.9. 73.650 mein 6 even hai, is liye 73.6; 64.350 mein 3 odd hai, is liye 64.4.
blocks.title: Easy words mein

blocks.text: Is rule se section (ii) ki calculation ka sahi answer 1.46 × 10³ hai.
Bohat si readings ki average value ke liye: uncertainty = average value se mean deviation. Periodic uncertainty: timing device (stopwatch) ke least count ko oscillations ki tadaad se divide karein.
blocks.title: Thumb Rule for Uncertainty

blocks.text: (iii) In adding or subtracting numbers (jama ya tafreeq)

Answer mein decimal places utne hi rakhein jitne add ya subtract hone wali quantities mein se sab se kam decimal places wali quantity mein hain. Yahan significant figures ki tadaad nahi, decimal ki position (jagah) dekhi jati hai. Example: metres mein di gayi yeh quantities add karni hain:
Case (i) mein 72.1 ke decimal places sab se kam (ek) hain, is liye answer 75.5 m. Case (ii) mein 4.10 ke decimal places sab se kam (do) hain, is liye answer 8.13 m.
Quick Quiz

blocks.prompt: 1. 0.0054 m, 0.03030 m, 40.0 m, 0.5 m aur 8.20 × 10⁷ m mein significant figures kitne hain?
blocks.explanation: 0.0054 m: do (shuru ke zero nahi ginte); 0.03030 m: chaar (3, darmiyan ka 0, 3, aakhri 0); 40.0 m: teen; 0.5 m: ek; 8.20 × 10⁷ m: teen.
Sum (jama) 2692.12 kg banta hai. Sab se kam decimal places 2602 kg mein hain (koi decimal place nahi), is liye answer 2692 kg.
Difference (farq) 1.14 kg hai. 2.4 kg mein ek decimal place hai, is liye answer 1.1 kg.
Calculation 1.674 × 10⁴ m deti hai. 3.6 mein sirf do significant figures hain, is liye answer 1.7 × 10⁴ m.

blocks.text: Limitations of Significant Figures (significant figures ki hadein)

Significant figures uncertainty ke sirf ek source (zariye) ko dikhate hain: scale parhne ki uncertainty. Asal experiment mein uncertainty kai wajah se aati hai, jaise personal error (napne wale ki apni ghalti) aur kabhi chhupi hui systematic errors (har baar ek hi taraf ki ghalti). Scale jitni ijazat de us se behtar reading nahi li ja sakti, magar total uncertainty significant figures ke andaze se kahin zyada bhi ho sakti hai.

ek jaisi accuracy (sab se kam significant figures)

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Significant figures = pakke maloom digits + pehla estimated digit; yeh instrument ki precision dikhate hain (3.145 g vs 3.1 g).
Zero ke rules: darmiyan wala significant; shuru wale nahi; decimal ke aakhir wale significant; integer mein least count se tay (8.000 × 10³ kg).
Multiply/divide: sab se kam significant figures (1.46 × 10³). Add/subtract: sab se kam decimal places (75.5 m, 8.13 m). Rounding: 5 se kam → waisa hi; 5 se zyada → 1 barhao; bilkul 5 → even ki taraf.
